semantic_catalog_core.note: Current production-intended jewelry-core catalog covers the existing Design Schema semantic boundary: jewelry type, metal, gemstone material, shape, cut, setting, orientation, color, style and selected construction terminology.

parametric_knowledge.note: ADR 0030 keeps sourced quantitative references separate from authoritative Product State and semantic Knowledge Library.

style_design_language_p0_10.note: Some concepts can normalize into current style/construction fields, but structural style, historical period, descriptive aesthetic, decorative technique, motif, composition and creative intent cannot be represented losslessly as independent current Product State targets.

terminology_normalization_p0_11.note: RU/EN mappings can use Knowledge Library language mappings when a canonical concept already exists. False-friend and ambiguity rules remain constrained by the current concept set.

reference_semantics_p0_11.note: Current AssetReference supports purpose design/material/style/proportion only; feature-level KEEP/CHANGE/LOCKED/INSPIRATION/UNKNOWN bindings are not part of Design Schema v1.0.0.

visualization_verification_p0_12.note: PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE, severity, evidence, actions and error taxonomy are verification state, not authoritative Product State and not representable by Knowledge Library v1 bundle records alone.

guardrails: Do not claim the 166 content-governed target paths/families are implemented in Jewelry Design Schema v1.0.0.
Do not collapse distinct P0-10 semantic layers into the single style field without an explicit schema decision.
Do not encode P0-12 verification outcomes as Product State facts.
Do not activate or promote a knowledge release merely because content baseline coverage is complete.
Exact runtime integration requires versioned schema/contract changes plus executable migration and regression validation.
next_versioned_slices: Recover and consolidate all P0-1 through P0-12 source artifacts into a canonical source package.

Produce an explicit mapping table from each content-governed target/path family to current Design Schema v1.0.0, an additive future schema field, interpretation metadata, reference binding metadata, verification state, or intentionally non-runtime content.
Version the Jewelry Design Schema additively for approved new Product State fields.
Version Knowledge Library policy target grammar to match the approved schema additions.
Add feature-level reference bindings without weakening existing reference lineage.
Introduce a separate visualization-verification result contract for P0-12.
Convert P0 semantic mini-tests and closure tests into executable runtime regression tests.
